name: reference
generationMethod: Initial 50-seed reference bank. First 50 uints in ascending order; nothing rolled out of the engine pre-flight. We expect to upgrade to a curated bank (e.g. "first 50 seeds where Ironclad A0 has at least one Neow choice with a boss relic") on bank version 2 once the harness is producing data we can use to filter. Seeds may only be APPENDED, never removed or reordered — a material content change is a new bank with a new name.
